homePage.metaTitle: Anonymous Internal Feedback Software for Modern Teams
homePage.metaDescription: Voxr helps teams collect anonymous internal feedback, employee ideas, praise, concerns, and comments inside a private workspace.
homePage.faq1Answer: Voxr is a SaaS product for anonymous internal company feedback. Employees can share ideas, praise, concerns, and comments inside a private workspace.
homePage.faq2Question: Who can see feedback in Voxr?
homePage.faq2Answer: Feedback is visible only to members of the same workspace, which keeps the conversation private to the relevant internal team or company environment.
homePage.faq3Question: Is Voxr just a suggestion box?
homePage.faq3Answer: No. Voxr is broader than a suggestion box. It supports ongoing internal feedback, comments, reactions, and structured forms when teams need them.
homePage.trustPoint1Description: Give employees a safer way to raise ideas, friction, and concerns before they become quiet frustration.
homePage.trustPoint2Description: Keep feedback inside the team or company workspace that should see it, instead of scattering sensitive input across exposed channels.
homePage.trustPoint3Description: Move beyond dead-end forms with comments, reactions, and a feed that keeps useful internal feedback visible.
homePage.heroTitle: Hear what your team really thinks.
homePage.heroDescription: Voxr is a private workspace where employees share honest, anonymous feedback — without fear and without noise.
homePage.whySubtitle: More honest than exposed internal channels. More useful than a forgotten suggestion box.
homePage.whyBody1: Voxr is designed for the part of internal communication that often breaks down first: the moment an employee decides whether it feels safe enough to speak honestly.
homePage.whyBody2: The product gives teams a lightweight feedback loop instead of another survey cadence or static form inbox.
homePage.goodFit1: Startup teams that want earlier feedback signals.
homePage.goodFit2: HR and people teams building safer feedback channels.
homePage.goodFit3: Operations leaders collecting internal process friction.
homePage.goodFit4: Remote and hybrid teams where honesty gets filtered by visibility.
homePage.faqSectionSubtitle: Questions teams ask before launching anonymous feedback
homePage.faqSectionDescription: The product itself is private behind login, so the public site needs to explain the model clearly for both humans and search systems. These are the common questions that define fit.
homePage.ctaTitle: Build a feedback channel employees will actually trust enough to use.
homePage.ctaDescription: Start with Voxr when your team needs anonymous internal feedback that is private, discussion-ready, and easier to turn into action.

productPage.metaDescription: Explore the Voxr product: anonymous internal feedback, private workspaces, comments, reactions, and forms for modern teams.
productPage.faq1Question: What can employees share in Voxr?
productPage.faq1Answer: Employees can share anonymous feedback, ideas, praise, concerns, comments, and structured form responses inside their workspace.
productPage.faq2Question: Is Voxr a public community platform?
productPage.faq2Answer: No. Voxr is designed for private internal use. Feedback is visible only to members of the same workspace.
productPage.faq3Question: Why include both posts and forms?
productPage.faq3Answer: Open-ended posts are useful when employees need speed and candor. Forms help when teams need more structure for recurring collection moments.
productPage.feature1Description: Capture day-to-day input in a living workspace feed instead of burying it in one-way submissions.
productPage.feature2Description: Keep useful feedback visible enough for clarification, discussion, and action instead of letting it disappear into a backlog.
productPage.feature3Description: Scope feedback to the relevant workspace so the conversation stays contextual and safer for employees.
productPage.intro: Voxr gives each team a private place for honest internal feedback.
productPage.body1: The product is designed around anonymous internal company feedback. Employees can share ideas, praise, concerns, and comments inside a workspace where the discussion stays relevant to the members who need it.
productPage.summaryBody: Voxr is a SaaS for anonymous internal company feedback. It helps teams collect honest input without forcing employees into exposed internal channels.
productPage.section1Title: Built for the truth employees usually hold back
productPage.section1Body: Voxr is not a general social feed. It is designed for the internal feedback moments that are easy to suppress in visible channels: frustrations, ideas, concerns, process observations, and praise employees want to share without creating unnecessary exposure.
productPage.section2Title: One product for open feedback and structured collection
productPage.section2Body: Teams can use feedback posts for always-on employee voice and use forms when they need more structure. That makes Voxr practical for day-to-day input and deliberate collection campaigns without fragmenting the workflow.
productPage.section3Title: Better fit for modern teams and startups
productPage.section3Body: Voxr works well for teams that want a lightweight internal feedback loop instead of another heavy process. The workspace model keeps context intact while making honest communication easier to sustain.

featuresPage.intro: Product features built for honest internal feedback, not just collection.
featuresPage.body: Voxr combines private workspaces, anonymous feedback posts, comments, reactions, and forms so teams can run a lighter feedback loop without splitting the workflow across multiple tools.
featuresPage.section1Body: Features matter most when employees and managers will actually use them repeatedly. Voxr is designed to keep the workflow simple enough for frequent use while still giving teams structure when they need it.
featuresPage.section2Title: A better fit than disconnected forms and exposed chat channels
featuresPage.section2Body: The feature set is aimed at one practical outcome: more useful employee honesty with less friction. That means a private place to speak, enough context to understand the issue, and a clear path to follow-up.

securityPage.metaTitle: Security and Privacy for Anonymous Internal Feedback
securityPage.metaDescription: Review how Voxr describes security and privacy for anonymous internal feedback, including private workspace visibility and careful product positioning.
securityPage.point1Description: Voxr is built for internal company use. Feedback is visible only to members of the same workspace rather than being published publicly.
securityPage.point2Description: The public site describes the product plainly so teams can understand what the private workspace model is designed to do without inflated claims.
securityPage.point3Description: The goal is to make honest employee feedback easier to share while keeping the conversation scoped to the relevant internal group.
securityPage.intro: A security and privacy page that matches the actual product model.
securityPage.body: Voxr is a private SaaS for anonymous internal company feedback. The product is positioned around safer internal communication inside workspaces, and this page is intentionally careful not to invent guarantees the product does not claim.
securityPage.summaryBody: Help evaluators understand the trust boundaries of the product: private workspace visibility, anonymous internal feedback, and a product description that stays grounded in what is actually known.
securityPage.section1Body: Voxr is designed so employees inside a workspace can share anonymous feedback, ideas, praise, concerns, and comments visible only to members of that same workspace. That is the core public trust boundary the site can explain clearly.
securityPage.section2Title: Honest positioning instead of inflated security copy
securityPage.section2Body: This implementation avoids unverifiable claims, fake compliance language, or invented assurances. Teams reviewing the product should be able to understand the model quickly without marketing noise.
securityPage.section3Title: A practical next step for evaluators
securityPage.section3Body: If the trust model fits your team, the next evaluation step is to review the product and feature pages and decide how you want to run feedback ownership, moderation, and follow-through internally.
